purpose: Defines the full-channel painterly PBR material targets for every active Infinite Brutality runtime material key.

referenceMaterial.description: The existing readable Meshy-derived rock PBR set is the visual and channel completeness reference for new Infinite Brutality materials.

styleRules: imperial, mechanical, industrial, or carved-stone identity
no flat vector-only replacement as final material
no UI symbols, text, logos, watermarks, or decorative wallpaper
large forms must read on mobile before micro-detail

materials.role: primary walkable imperial fortress masonry and carved slab surfaces
materials.surfaceRead: broad dressed gray-blue stone blocks cut into fortress rock, worn edges, dust in seams, readable footing
materials.prompt: Seamless tileable painterly PBR material, imperial sky-fortress dressed stone floor slabs carved from blue gray rock, broad block seams, chipped worn edges, quarry dust, low-poly readable forms, mobile game material, full albedo normal roughness metalness height intent.
materials.negativePrompt: text, letters, symbols, UI, wallpaper pattern, tiny cobbles, photoreal concrete, flat vector art, excessive cracks, high frequency noise
materials.processing: OpenAI-generated painterly albedo source copied into project assets; technical normal, roughness, metalness, height, ao, and emissive channels derived locally.

generatedTextureSet.processing: Deterministic local Pillow generation from manifest palettes, families, roles, surfaceRead fields, and runtime params. Produces painterly tileable albedo, normal, roughness, metalness, height, ao, and emissive channels as declared.
generatedTextureSet.rejectionReason: Output read as procedural placeholder/crayon texture and replaced existing rock direction when hooked up.
